label: FarDriver ND72360
studioTitle: Bright green electronic control unit with connectors.
notes: Bluetooth sinewave ND72360-W. Green ECU with phase, Hall, and ignition connectors. Sample in hand (~$199).

label: Dual-magnet bar clamp
studioTitle: Black two-sided mirror with adjustable arm.
notes: Center 22.2 mm clamp. MagSafe pad (raised ring, ~3 mm) on the short arm for the phone dash; 4.5″ magnet on the longer arm for the detachable windscreen. Both faces point at the rider.

label: Detachable windscreen
studioTitle: Translucent brown shield with mounting holes.
notes: Smoked shield, 17″ tall, 13″ wide at the bottom, tapering toward the top. 4.5″ rider-facing magnet snaps to the long arm of the bar clamp. Detaches for travel.

label: Front fork
studioTitle: Metal U-shaped object with two protruding ends.
notes: Rigid U-blade fork for the 20×4 front wheel. Dropout slots on both ends; steerer for the 44 mm head tube. Pairs with the 20×4 rim and street tire on order.

label: 72V to 12V DC-DC
studioTitle: Metallic heat sink with three wires attached.
notes: Finned buck converter. Drops pack voltage to 12V for the LoRa TX/RX, lights, and ignition. Cllena unit on the way (~$20).

label: Folding frame
studioTitle: Metal component with various attachment points.
notes: Carbon steel folding chassis, 9.2 lb. 190 mm rear dropout for the QS205 50H 3T. 44 mm head tube. AliExpress frame inbound.

label: Rear shock
studioTitle: Metal and rubber component with threaded ends.
notes: Rear shock for the Kalosse folding frame. Eyelet mounts, rubber-sleeved body. Comes with the inbound chassis.

label: Torque arm — left
studioTitle: Black metal bracket on wooden surface.
notes: Left-side QS205 / M16 anti-rotate plate. Keep this side open for the disc rotor, caliper, and phase/Hall cables.

label: Torque arm — right
studioTitle: Black metal bracket on wooden surface.
notes: Right-side QS205 / M16 anti-rotate plate. Mirror of the left; same 3D, opposite dropout.

label: QS205 V3 50H 3T hub motor
studioTitle: Black wheel with gear mechanism attached.
notes: QS205 V3 (50H) 3T spoke hub, 190 mm dropout, 20×4.0. 28.6 lb. 5,000W continuous / 12,000W peak. Disc 6-bolt (6×44). HAVE.

label: Mount bolt + nylon washer
studioTitle: Metal bolt with a plastic washer attached.
notes: Grade 8 fastener with a nylon isolator washer. Seat pan, stay clamps, and shock eyelets — keeps the chassis from metal-to-metal rattle.

label: Hex-head bolt
studioTitle: Metal bolt with hexagonal head and shaft.
notes: Grade 8 hex-head bolt. Frame, rack, and dropout hardware — pairs with the nylon-washer isolator bolt.

label: Cable P-clamp
studioTitle: Metal clip with screw and washer attachment.
notes: P-clamp with screw and washer. Routes phase/Hall and 12V looms along the left stay, clear of the disc.

label: Fold-hinge pin
studioTitle: Metal cylindrical object with a hole.
notes: Clevis / fold-lock pin with a cross-hole. Holds the carbon-steel chassis open for riding; pulls for travel fold.

label: Nylon isolator bushing
studioTitle: Small, light-colored circular plastic object.
notes: Shoulder bushing for the café racer seat pan and stay clamps. Isolates vibration between the seat/rack and the carbon-steel frame.

label: Nylon washer
studioTitle: Small white circular plastic washer on surface.
notes: Flat nylon washer. Sits under hex-head bolts and P-clamp screws so hardware doesn’t chew the frame paint.

label: Threadlocker bolt
studioTitle: Metallic bolt with blue threaded section.
notes: Cap-head bolt with blue (medium) threadlocker. Rotor, caliper, and torque-arm fasteners that must not back out at 70 mph.

label: Round-head screw
studioTitle: Metallic screw with rounded ends, threaded shaft.
notes: Button / pan-head screw through a spacer sleeve. Lighter fixtures: P-clamps, dash clamp, plastics — not rotor or axle.

label: Headset bearing
studioTitle: Small white circular object on surface.
notes: Sealed cartridge for the 44 mm head tube (ZS44 / 28.6 mm steerer). Pairs with the crown race, star nut, and top cap.

label: Electrical tape
studioTitle: Small, circular, adhesive tape roll.
notes: Loom / electrical tape. Wraps phase/Hall and 12V bundles, dielectric on QS8 boots, strain relief on the pack leads.

label: O-ring seal
studioTitle: Small, circular, translucent plastic ring on surface.
notes: Translucent elastomer O-ring. Headset dust seal, QS8 boots, and pack lock faces — keeps the IP65 rating.
